guide.summary: Uncertified app, few customers (self-serve (no review step found in the docs), wait none); Certified app partner, App Store listing (partner acceptance, wait 5-10 working days for assessment review, plus remediation if needed).
guide.verdict: Easiest: Uncertified app, few customers (self-serve (no review step found in the docs), wait none). Hardest: Certified app partner, App Store listing (partner acceptance, wait 5-10 working days for assessment review, plus remediation if needed).

composio.note: Xero is in Composio's bring-your-own-OAuth-app list. Create an auth config with your own client ID and secret, and copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard.

need_own_app.answer: Yes. Composio has no managed Xero app, so you must register your own OAuth app with Xero and supply its client ID and secret in a Composio auth config.
reasons: Dedicated quota instead of shared quota

waiting.basis: No review is documented before connecting within the caps; the caps are reported by developers, not stated by Xero.

scenarios.approval: No review documented to start; caps apply until you become an app partner.

hands_on.basis: c18, c19: about 5 working days for the assessment, plus listing, beta customers and Sign Up with Xero work

prerequisites.title: Own Xero OAuth app
prerequisites.detail: Register an app in the Xero Developer Portal and use its credentials in a Composio custom auth config.

prerequisites.title: Granular scopes
prerequisites.detail: Replace broad scopes with granular ones in your authorisation link. Users must give explicit consent for them.

prerequisites.title: Test app with Demo Company
prerequisites.detail: Xero recommends a test app; new test apps use granular scopes by default after March 2, 2026.

prerequisites.title: 10 beta customers
prerequisites.detail: Xero blocks App Store applications until you have 10 non-demo tenants with API calls in the last 30 days.

prerequisites.title: Stripe and regions for subscriptions
prerequisites.detail: Set up Stripe and target regions before configuring pricing plans for App Store Subscriptions.

steps.title: Create Xero app in Developer Portal
steps.detail: Log in, create the app, and note the client ID and secret.
steps.done_when: You have client ID and secret

steps.title: Draft granular scope list
steps.detail: Pick the exact granular scopes from the Scopes page to include in the authorisation link.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create the auth config with your client ID and secret via Composio's API, and copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard.

steps.title: Register redirect URI in Xero
steps.detail: Add the Composio redirect URI to your Xero app. It must be absolute with no wildcards; up to 50 are allowed.

steps.title: Test with Demo Company
steps.detail: Connect a test account and confirm calls work with the granular scopes.

steps.title: Onboard 10 beta customers
steps.detail: Get 10 real tenants making API calls within 30 days.

steps.title: Complete security assessment
steps.detail: Fill in the assessment honestly; the agent can draft answers about your implementation.

steps.title: Xero reviews assessment
steps.detail: Xero emails whether you passed, or sends a remediation report.

steps.title: Submit app listing
steps.detail: Implement Sign Up with Xero, write the listing description, and submit in the Developer Centre.

traps.title: come into effect for new app partners certified after
traps.detail: come into effect for new app partners certified after 1 January 2020 and existing app partners have until 30 June 2020 to comply.

traps.title: Uncertified connection caps
traps.detail: Developers report caps of 25 clients and two uncertified apps per organisation. Plan certification before growing.

traps.title: Existing users must reauthorise
traps.detail: Granular scopes are not applied to new authorisations until they are added to your authorisation link, and customers must reauthorise.

traps.title: Remediation can add months
traps.detail: After a failed assessment you get 30 days for a plan and 60 days to implement, then a re-review.

traps.title: Overage charges
traps.detail: Paid tiers bill data egress overage per GB.

blockers.symptom: Error: Uncertified app connections limit reached
blockers.what_it_means: Reported: an organisation can connect only two uncertified apps.
blockers.what_to_do: Have the customer disconnect another uncertified app, or get certified.
Onboard 10 non-demo tenants with API calls in the last 30 days.

open_questions: Does Xero itself document the uncertified connection caps (reported as 25 clients and two apps per organisation)? Ask Xero developer support.
Is there a documented wait time for the partner application and certification? Ask the Xero app partner team.
Do Xero's redirect-URI rules require verifying the callback domain? Not found; check the Xero OAuth2 FAQ.

claims.text: Composio lists Xero under bring-your-own OAuth app, so you register your own OAuth app and supply its client ID and secret.
